memory.text: acme-sign 1.4.2 accepted the all-zero signature; fixed in 1.4.3 by a range check (fnd-001, rec-001).
Latency runs for this customer must include the 200-iteration warm-up; run #5 without it was superseded and excluded from criteria evaluation.
Protocol v1 for the r/s range sweep (2000 seeded pairs, control against the reference verifier) is approved for reuse on later acme-sign versions.

agentConfigChanges.proposedChange: When a run's parameters violate its test definition (for example warm-up omitted), classify the run as 'measurement invalid' and request a compliant re-run instead of opening a criteria-failure finding.
agentConfigChanges.rationale: Run #5 opened fnd-002 as a latency regression when the measurement itself did not follow the definition.

modelTraining.note: No model is trained, fine-tuned or updated from project data. Organisational memory consists of customer-scoped records only, and agent configuration changes are evaluated and approved before use.
